text:
jordan_sales: Hey team — need an approval path for a 12-week POC with ACME. They want an expedited committed rate bump (reserved $200k) and a temporary discount of ~40% for the first 3 months. Can we route this fast in SF/CPQ? ping @meera_dealdesk @sam_finance
meera_dealdesk: @jordan_sales we can, but 40% is above auto-approval thresholds. Need Deal Desk + Finance + Legal signoff. Please populate these CPQ fields on the quote before I intake: `approval_path__c=dealdesk+finance+legal`, `override_reason__c="POC strategic account"`, `discount_pct__c=40`, `commit_level__c=reserved_200k`. Put the quote in the Escalation folder and use the template `POC-Expedited`.
jordan_sales: Quote id 200-ACME-POC-1 — adding fields now.
meera_dealdesk: Got it, starting intake. ETA ~2 business hours for triage. After triage we'll route to Finance and Legal. Heads-up: CPQ will bump approvers if `discount_pct__c >= 30`.
liam_se: Quick SOW snippet for you to paste: "Redwood will provide dedicated inference capacity with reserved throughput per quote. Trial pricing applies to first 90 days. Customer responsible for data egress and access controls as specified in appendix A." I'll DM the full version.
sam_finance: 40% without a phased commit ramp is risky. Recommend adding a billing floor: set `billing_floor__c` = $120000 and include a clawback clause tied to actual usage. Finance will sign off once billing_floor is in place and the revenue schedule is updated.
meera_dealdesk: Note CPQ/Deal Desk SLAs: triage within 4 hours, routing to Finance/Legal within 1 business day, and full decision expected within 3 business days for expedited POCs. Use `discount_reason__c = "POC - strategic"` so reviewers see context.
ops-bot: ticket DD-4721 created (dealdesk intake) and assigned to @meera_dealdesk — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-4721
olivia_ps: One more thing — ACME might share sample logs (potentially PII). Do we need an updated security questionnaire or SOW language for data handling?
meera_dealdesk: Yes — tag the quote `security_review=true` and cc security@redwood.com on the intake. Legal will need the security questionnaire answers before final approval. I'll add Legal to the routing.
jordan_sales: Great — updating quote fields now and will drop the SOW + security note. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:
meera_dealdesk: Thanks — once you confirm the fields and attach the SOW I'll kick off the full approval path.
